Class CardAddedBuilding

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.BuildingCard
it.polimi.ingsw.model.BuildingCards.CardAddedBuilding
public class CardAddedBuilding extends BuildingCard
Represents a specialized type of BuildingCard that triggers bonuses when specific card combinations or duplicates are added to a player's tribe. It tracks parameters for rewarding sets of characters or duplicate inventors.

  • Constructor Details

    • CardAddedBuilding

      public CardAddedBuilding(String id, int era, int minPlayer, boolean isObtainable, int foodCost, int prestigePoints, boolean bonusOnDuplicateInventor, boolean bonusOnSetCharacters, int foodBonus, int setDim)
      Constructs a new CardAddedBuilding with the specified game rules, costs, and bonus triggers.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the card
      era - the historical era or age this card belongs to
      minPlayer - the minimum number of players required for this card to be active
      isObtainable - true if the card can currently be acquired by players
      foodCost - the amount of food required to construct/buy this building
      prestigePoints - the raw prestige or victory points awarded by this card
      bonusOnDuplicateInventor - true if this building grants a bonus for having duplicate inventors
      bonusOnSetCharacters - true if this building grants a bonus for completing sets of characters
      foodBonus - the amount of food bonus provided when a condition is met
      setDim - the required size (dimension) of a character set to trigger the bonus
